title: Wilma's Place: A Nashville Retreat
description:
WELCOME TO THE WILMA'S PLACE GUESTHOUSE! Enjoy a comfortable night's rest in your spacious master bedroom with half bath. Ready to freshen up? Saunter into your spacious modern bathroom with amenities listed. There is another queen size bed and full bath. The guesthouse is conveniently located 2.5 miles to downtown, 1.2 miles to 12South and blocks away from 8th ave south where you can enjoy Nashville hot chicken,comedy club, local juice bar etc... Free parking is located on the premises.

The space
This charming guesthouse is located behind a separate main house.  The guesthouse includes 1 full bedroom and 1.5 bathrooms.  There are two Queen beds with a door separating both spaces.  The house was designed for you to feel right at home.

Guest access
Guests have full access to the entire guest suite including private parking.

Other things to note
Guests do not have access to the main house. All communication and interaction should remain with hosts!
